source: docs/content/REVIEW_REPORT_20261001.md section 4 on branch content/review-20261001 (independent review, 2026-10-01). Each case is the reviewer's defective field set; the test applies it on top of the current good entry for that code and requires the validator to reject it with the named rule. Extended 2026-10-02 (owner decision D1) with the 8 defective entries written by the batch 1 reviewer (REVIEW_REPORT_BATCH1_20261001.md section D; review_validator_defeat_20261001.py on branch content/review-batch1-20261001), which the validator of that date accepted with zero errors. Extended 2026-10-02 (V5, owner decision G1) with the 8 defective entries of the independent review of V4 (REVIEW_REPORT_V4_20261002.md section D, review_attacks_v4_20261002.py on branch content/review-v4-20261002), which the V4 validator accepted with zero errors; rules Q1 to Q8 reject them.

cases.name: Defect 1: wrong direction (P0123 carrying the P0122 meaning)

fields.title_en: Throttle position sensor A: voltage below threshold
fields.meaning_en: The throttle position sensor signal is lower than the bike's computer (ECU) expects, often from a short to ground.

cases.name: Defect 2: ABS advice that endangers a rider (C0035)

fields.rider_advice_en: Braking is not affected, so ride as normal. The ABS lamp can wait until the next service.

cases.name: Defect 3: car-only EGR valve as a cause (P0172)
Bonus defect: level contradicts the entry's own text (U0155)

fields.rider_action_basis: engine may stall or not start
fields.rider_advice_en: The engine may cut out or refuse to start while riding. Get it checked soon.

cases.name: Batch1 defect D1: 'shuts off ... will not restart' at SERVICE_SOON (P0130)

fields.rider_advice_en: The engine will shut off suddenly at speed and will not restart. Get it checked soon.
fields.can_ride_reason: engine shuts off without warning; keep riding to the workshop

cases.name: Batch1 defect D2: fuel pump control circuit open set to SERVICE_SOON with the TWO-CASE sentence (P0627)

fields.rider_advice_en: The engine may be hard to start. If the engine runs normally, have it checked soon; if it stalls or will not start, do not keep riding.
fields.can_ride_reason: ride only if the engine runs normally

cases.name: Batch1 defect D3: direction reversed in advice and reason, temperature HIGH voltage (P0118)

fields.rider_action_basis: cooling may switch on too often
fields.rider_advice_en: The engine looks hotter than it is, so cooling may switch on more often than needed. There is no risk of overheating; get it checked at the next service.
fields.can_ride_reason: cooling runs too often only; safe in traffic and heat

cases.name: Batch1 defect D4: ABS sentence followed by a reassuring sentence (U0121)

fields.rider_advice_en: Your normal brakes still work, but ABS is off, so a wheel can lock in hard braking. There is no need to ride differently in the rain.
fields.can_ride_reason: brakes work, ABS off; fine in the rain and at full speed

cases.name: Batch1 defect D5: fuel leak and fire risk without the word smell, 'keep riding' (P0172)

fields.rider_action_basis: fuel may leak onto the hot engine
fields.rider_advice_en: Fuel may be leaking onto the hot engine and fumes can build up. Wipe it off and keep riding; get it checked soon.
fields.can_ride_reason: fuel may drip onto the engine; usually rideable

cases.name: Batch1 defect D6: unsafe technician hints (bypass, jumper wire, battery lead off while running) (P0850)

technician_hints_en: Bypass the neutral switch with a jumper wire to see whether the bike starts
Check the switch connector for oil, water and corrosion
Take a battery lead off while the engine is running to see if the fault clears

cases.name: Batch1 bonus B7: 'if you like' used as a loophole (P0109)

fields.rider_advice_en: Ride on if you like, because the engine will stall without warning in traffic. Get it checked when convenient.

cases.name: Batch1 bonus B8: STOP entry that permits riding on (P0335)

fields.rider_advice_en: Pull over safely, switch off and do not keep riding. If you must, you can still ride gently home at normal speed.
fields.can_ride_reason: safe to ride home gently; workshop can wait

cases.name: V4 review attack A1: Always-true 'if' hides a near-certain stall and no-restart claim at SERVICE_SOON (R3 and R12 loophole)

fields.rider_advice_en: If you ride in traffic, the engine will stall and will not restart. If it stalls more than once or will not restart, do not keep riding; have it taken to a workshop.

cases.name: V4 review attack A2: Fire risk written with words R16 does not know (seeping, vapour, hot engine) and no PETROL sentence

fields.rider_action_basis: fuel seeping onto the hot engine
fields.rider_advice_en: Fuel may be seeping from the injector onto the hot engine and vapour can collect under the seat. Ride gently and get it checked soon.

cases.name: V4 review attack A3: Direction reversed on a 'Too Low' standard title (R6 and R14 skip 'too low' and 'too high' titles)

fields.meaning_en: The bike's computer (ECU) found that the engine oil pressure is above the safe limit, which can quickly damage the engine.

cases.name: V4 review attack A4: Brake light switch code downgraded to MONITOR, reassuring, review false, confidence high

fields.rider_advice_en: The brake light is a minor matter. The bike rides normally; get the switch checked at the next service.

cases.name: V4 review attack A5: STOP advice tells the rider to open the hot radiator cap (R17 checks technician hints only)

fields.rider_advice_en: Pull over safely, switch off and do not keep riding; have the bike taken to a workshop. Open the radiator cap at once to let the steam out and add cold water.

cases.name: V4 review attack A6: Brake fluid loss implied by an ABS pump entry that stays SERVICE_SOON (nothing checks braking hydraulics)

likely_causes_en: Low brake fluid or a leaking brake line
Pump motor seized after long inactivity
technician_hints_en: Check the brake fluid level and top it up if it is low
Check the ABS pump motor supply and ground connections

cases.name: V4 review attack B1: Bonus: wheel position named in meaning and hint of a wheel speed entry (owner rule: position-neutral)

fields.meaning_en: The ABS control unit found a fault in the left front wheel speed sensor, so ABS is probably switched off.
technician_hints_en: Replace the left front wheel speed sensor first
Check the sensor signal on the scan tool while the wheel turns

cases.name: V4 review attack B2: Bonus: can_ride_reason contradicts the level and the entry's own warning (lean mixture overheats the engine)

fields.can_ride_reason: ride normally; long trips are fine
